newsitem.title: USA: SBC, PacTel deal-doom talk is posturing-arbs.
newsitem.headline: SBC, PacTel deal-doom talk is posturing-arbs.

text.p: SBC Communications Inc is expected to close its proposed $17 billion acquisition of Pacific Telesis Group, despite talk by the companies that the deal is in peril due to concessions recommended to California regulators, according to arbitrageurs.
"We are not taking the companies' statements particularly seriously. It is posturing. It is standard to hear tough talk out of them," said an arb who declined to be identified.
On Friday, two administrative law judges who make recommendations to the California Public Utilities Commission, issued a proposed approval of the merger.
